previous.observation: Fresh root actual raw, full white/black, nape-curl double-background2x, original full-palm PV guide and old saved correct-root API viewed. Changed reference hypothesis to old whole correct-nape target plus user's turns-only crop excluded head/beads successfully restores two-red-bead anatomical LEFT imageRIGHT root behind lower ear/bob edge BELOW outer eye. Curl falls naturally beside original shoulder and no longer crosses behind thumb. Original head tilt/open single dark eyes/glints/gentle closed-arc smile, healthy warm peach skin, two attached cap leaves, full raised black-gloved palm/fingers/forearm-bottom and cap-top crop, gray-green collar/sleeves/bodice with black bow/gold clasp/white frills preserved. Broad connected gray opaque front/return and muted mint taper retained; self-overlap and actual frill/clothing behind it legitimately hide axis, no fixed air-hole count. No obvious large dark underside or glossy streaks, no pasted seams. P2 lower turns narrow fairly quickly and have small gray/mint tonal/facet differences when enlarged; not exact single-pigment or hidden full-curl certification. Root static candidate only pending fresh Sol; no exposure/placement/dynamic/user pass.
